name: A Memory That Walks
description:
The hoofprints end at a dry riverbed. Whatever passed this way left its death behind.

Obtain an Undead Soul from a skeleton horse and check the Undead Eye recipe in JEI. This rare route is optional. Earn End Remastered's undead eye advancement by obtaining the eye. This record keeps working after you use the eye. Eyes are never consumed by this quest. Loot can be random; choose other routes for the portal if a source proves elusive.
